metadata.tags: Hyper-compressed electronicore-dubstep hybrid with female vocals; thick growling bass and rapid kawaii leads. Verses stay tense with stuttering glitches, filtered vocals and sparse chords; choruses detonate into layered supersaws, stacked harmonies and aggressive growls. Drop sections slam with cinematic hits, syncopated half-time drums, and chopped vocal motifs. Reverb-laden top line soars above the chaos, with gentle sidechain breathing the whole mix., cinematic dubstep, soaring, rapid, electronic, anime, electronicore

metadata.gpt_description_prompt: Thick, growling bass pulses under rapid-fire synths and sparkling kawaii bass leads, fusing with soaring, reverb-laden vocals processed for an otherworldly touch. Japanese anime-inspired samples and melodic motifs blend with heavy cinematic dubstep drops and glitchy, electronicore breakdowns; verses are tense, with digital effects swirling, choruses explode with layered aggression and vibrant electronic textures, lyrics reflecting escape and self-empowerment.
